text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Social Democratic party said on Wednesday that the country's government was privatising key companies in the telecommunication, transport and energy sectors without having a clear programme and it will end in economic decline, rising prices and job cuts.
- The Vilnius prosecutor's office is expected to finish the investigation of the case of former finance minister Romas Matiliauskas on Thursday.
Matiliauskas is suspected of abusing his position while working in a private bank and receiving an $18,000 soft loan.
